FORM bind_order.
  READ TABLE gt_prod_ord_list ASSIGNING <gs_prod_ord_list> INDEX 2.
  READ TABLE gt_prod_ord_list WITH KEY id = 99 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
ENDFORM.

FORM release_order.
  UNASSIGN <gs_prod_ord_list>.
ENDFORM.

" ASSIGNING aliases each row, INTO copies it; itab[] is the table body.
FORM pick_list.
  DATA lt_prod_ord_pick_list TYPE ty_orders.
  DATA ls_pick TYPE ty_order.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_prod_ord_pick_list> LIKE LINE OF lt_prod_ord_pick_list.
  lt_prod_ord_pick_list = gt_prod_ord_list.
  LOOP AT lt_prod_ord_pick_list[] ASSIGNING <ls_prod_ord_pick_list>.
    <ls_prod_ord_pick_list>-qty = <ls_prod_ord_pick_list>-qty * 2.
  ENDLOOP.
  LOOP AT lt_prod_ord_pick_list[] INTO ls_pick.
    ls_pick-qty = 0.
  ENDLOOP.
  LOOP AT lt_prod_ord_pick_list[] ASSIGNING <ls_prod_ord_pick_list>.
    WRITE / <ls_prod_ord_pick_list>-qty.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.

" INTO a field symbol fills the data object it is bound to, not the row.
FORM dynamic_into.
  DATA lv_total TYPE i.
  DATA ls_work TYPE ty_order.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                 <lv_line> TYPE any.
  ASSIGN gt_prod_ord_list TO <lt_table>.
  ASSIGN ls_work TO <lv_line>.
  LOOP AT <lt_table> INTO <lv_line>.
    lv_total = lv_total + ls_work-qty.
    CLEAR <lv_line>.
  ENDLOOP.
  WRITE / lv_total.
  READ TABLE gt_prod_ord_list INTO ls_work INDEX 1.
  WRITE / ls_work-qty.
ENDFORM.

FORM build_dynamic.
  CREATE DATA gr_table TYPE ty_orders.
  ASSIGN gr_table->* TO <gt_dyn_table>.
  CREATE DATA gr_line LIKE LINE OF <gt_dyn_table>.
  ASSIGN gr_line->* TO <gv_line>.
ENDFORM.

FORM fill_dynamic.
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <gv_line> TO <lv_field>.
  <lv_field> = 7.
  ASSIGN COMPONENT 'QTY' OF STRUCTURE <gv_line> TO <lv_field>.
  <lv_field> = 70.
  APPEND <gv_line> TO <gt_dyn_table>.
  <lv_field> = 71.
  APPEND <gv_line> TO <gt_dyn_table>.
ENDFORM.

FORM show_dynamic.
  LOOP AT <gt_dyn_table> ASSIGNING <gv_alv_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'QTY' OF STRUCTURE <gv_alv_line> TO <lv_field>.
    WRITE / <lv_field>.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
